title: Luxurious Vacation in Thailand with FREE Tickets to Siam Niramit Show
highlights: Spend an amazing vacation in Thailand and explore some of the iconic landmarks from its stunning locations like Phuket, Koh Samui, and Krabi.
Explore the stunning James Bond Island that gained international fame as it got featured in the 1974 James Bond movie "The Man with the Golden Gun."
Enjoy the "Must-see Show of Thailand," Siam Niramit, which has won both national and international awards and learn about Thailand's culture and history.
Stroll through Koh Ang Thong Marine Park and enjoy watching a variety of exotic species of mammals, sea creatures, birds, reptiles, and trees.
Experience the thrill as you visit the Tiger Kingdom in Phuket, where you can safely interact with tigers up close and capture pictures with these amazing animals.
overview:
About The Destination:
Imagine a tranquil escape to a hidden valley where time stands still and lush forested hills surround you with an air of peace and untroubled solitude. Visualize a tropical paradise so serene, so filled with magnificent coves, powdery, palm-fringed white beaches, sparkling island-dotted seas, charmingly hospitable people and tantalizing cuisines. Capture the romance in a blissful paradise where the world seemingly revolves around only the two of you. Described by visitors as “love at first sight”, the name of this place is Phuket. Combine it with the luxurious Amatara, a sanctuary for the senses on the shores of Cape Panwa, where guests indulge in style and blissful relaxation in the best of the Tropics.

know_before_you_go: You should carry your passport and visa at the time of arrival.
With the tropical climate, staying hydrated is essential. Drink bottled water and avoid tap water to prevent waterborne illnesses.

The currency used in Thailand is the Thai Baht (THB) so familiarize yourself with the current exchange rate and ensure you have enough cash or access to ATMs, especially if you plan to visit rural areas.
Adhere to designated smoking areas and respect non-smoking areas, which may include indoor spaces and certain outdoor areas.
Any personal expenses or items of a personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Phuket
days.desc: Welcome to Phuket, the city known for its white sands and beautiful temples! Upon your landing at Phuket International Airport, you'll be driven to your hotel for check-in. Post-check-in, enjoy your day at leisure, where you can visit the beautiful Ao Nang. Next, you can visit the Phuket Fanta Sea, the Phuket Trickeye Museum, Phuket Bird Park, and more places. Post-exploration, return to your hotel on your own for a comfortable overnight stay.

days.title: Siam Niramit Evening Show
days.desc: In the morning, explore the city at your own pace. You can enjoy fun water activities at Andamanda, Phuket's largest waterpark, followed by a visit to the Phuket Elephant Sanctuary. Then, head to Aquaria Phuket, one of Thailand's largest aquariums, before returning to your hotel on your own. In the evening, board the pre-booked transfer from the hotel to see the Siam Niramit Show, depicting Thailand’s history and culture. Later, you'll be transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: James Bond Island Day Tour
days.desc: Board your transfer to Ao Por Pier and take the speed boat for your day trip to James Bond Island. Upon reaching, explore the beautiful island by visiting beautiful sea caves and taking a dip in its crystal-clear water. Next, admire the scenic landscape of the Muslim fishing village on the island of Koh Panyee. After an adventurous day, board your speedboat to the Ao Por Pier, from where you'll be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Koh Samui
days.desc: After you check-out from your hotel, get driven to Donsak Pier to board your ferry for the beautiful island in the Gulf of Thailand, Koh Samui. Upon reaching Nathon Pier, disembark from your ferry, after which you'll be driven to your hotel for check-in. Later, you can head out and explore some vibrant markets like the Wharf Samui and the Fishermans Village. As the day winds up, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Koh Ang Thong Marine Park
days.desc: Today, board your transfer for an excursion to the Ang Thong Marine Park. Upon reaching Nathon Pier, take the speed boat and enjoy a scenic journey to Koh Ang Thong Marine Park. Visit the Wua Talap viewpoint to get an amazing view of the green sea below. Also, witness some of the most popular islands in the 42-island-wide archipelago of the marine park. Continue to Mae Koh Island and admire the iconic Emerald Lake. After an amazing day, you'll be taken back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Leisure Day in Koh Samui
days.desc: Enjoy this day at your own pace, exploring the city and indulging in fun activities. You can visit the famous Big Buddha Temple and witness various statues of Buddha in different forms and sizes. Next, you can visit the Hin Ta & Hin Yai Rocks, Wat Plai Laem, Na Muang Waterfall, Secret Buddha Garden, and many more attractions throughout the day. Later in the evening, you can relax at Chaweng Beach before heading back to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Krabi
days.desc: In the morning, board the pre-booked transfer from the hotel for Nathon Pier and take the ferry for Krabi. Upon reaching Klong Jilad Pier, disembark your ferry and get driven to the hotel for check-in. Afterward, spend your day at leisure and witness famous attractions in Krabi, like the Krabi Elephant Sanctuary and Krabi Weekend Night Market. If you want, you can also visit the famous Wat Tham Sua before heading back to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Krabi 7 Islands Tour
days.desc: Have a memorable day as you head out for the Krabi 7 Islands Tour. From your hotel, get transferred to Nopparat Thara Pier and embark on a long-tail boat for a scenic journey to some of the best islands around Krabi. You can start by enjoying snorkeling at Yawasom Island, followed by a visit to Tang Ming Island for more fun activities. See the uniquely shaped Chicken Island and wander around the Natural Sand Bridge at Tup Island. Later, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Leisure Day in Krabi
days.desc: Today, spend your day at leisure, where you can visit the refreshing Emerald Pool and indulge in fun water activities. You can also visit the famous Tiger Cave Temple and Ko Phi Phi Island for some adventurous activities. Experience the warm water of Klong Thom Hot Springs, and you can visit the Mud Crabs Sculpture. Later, head back to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: Pack your bag full of memories and check-out from your hotel. Then, you'll be driven to Krabi Airport to board your flight back home, marking the end of this trip.
